evidence_against: The maturation trigger is false: matured_outcome_delta is 24, below the frozen minimum of 25 required for a new learning claim. This review was triggered by an escalation fingerprint change and milestone, not sufficient new maturation.

Candidate-level results do not support broad title-level generalization. BTC mark-price RANGE includes supported candidates with 56, 39, and 9 matured outcomes, but also not-supported candidates with 2, 1, and 1. BTC mark-price DOWN is supported at 31 outcomes but not supported at 10.
ETH mark-price RANGE is internally challenged: one candidate is supported with 5 outcomes, while candidates with 6 and 1 outcomes are not supported. These small samples are not learning claims.

Every item in the 14-candidate escalation queue includes REPLICATION_UNVERIFIED, including candidates also labeled REPLICATED_FIRED. Fired replication is therefore not equivalent to verified independent replication.

Supportive candidates still require baseline, control, regime, complexity, incremental-value, and adversarial review according to the supplied adjudication reasons. No such comparative results are supplied.

The experiment registry reports scientific_admission_status as null for matured candidates, while the weekly escalation queue labels the same candidates QUALIFIED_FOR_FORWARD_TEST. This disagreement prevents treating admission status as settled.
Eight candidates are TARGET_UNIT_QUARANTINED and cannot supply admissible directional or range evidence until unit integrity is established.
Most of the registry is not mature evidence: 115 candidates are INCUBATING, 32 are MATURED_INCONCLUSIVE, 24 await mapping, 7 await data, and 1 awaits maturity.
The sensor-combination candidates shown have only one matured outcome each and are inconclusive; they are merely interesting, not learned.
Action Compass calibration has zero sidecars and zero matured rows and is explicitly descriptive-only, so it contributes no outcome learning.
The shared-row snapshot is still COLLECTING with no relevance state or summary. The shadow registry has only one scorable item, eight requiring recovery, and no promotion candidates.
Redundancy is substantial: weekly adjudication marks 90 of 201 candidates ARCHIVE_ONLY_DUPLICATE, while another 66 require more prospective evidence.

Automation health is RED because daily-slow-cycle-shadow has two consecutive failures. Nine registered workflows also lack local files, and unified lifecycle adjudication is schedule-stale; the effect on evidence completeness is unknown.

No exact horizons, target thresholds or range bounds, primary scores, baseline results, regime partitions, timestamp overlap analysis, or effect estimates are supplied. Candidate titles alone are insufficient to aggregate outcomes.
evidence_for: Prospective outcome infrastructure contains substantive matured evidence: architecture health reports 179 adjudicated matured outcomes with zero censoring in its 14-day evidence-health view.

Eight candidates are classified MATURED_SUPPORTED. The largest supplied cohorts are BTC mark-price RANGE EC-0dc8abd903144198e36e with 56 outcomes, ETH mark-price DOWN EC-4e02e53e58c3e79ba871 with 47, ETH DOWN EC-5c8b675adec8111650dd with 41, BTC RANGE EC-23f2161a31fe1f482e99 with 39, and BTC DOWN EC-62dc79b74bb6526e7c67 with 31.

The ETH mark-price DOWN cluster has three supported candidates with 47, 41, and 11 matured outcomes. This is the most consistently supportive same-title cluster supplied, although exact specifications and independence are missing.

The BTC mark-price RANGE cluster contains two comparatively large supported cohorts with 56 and 39 outcomes, making its unresolved conflict with smaller not-supported counterparts scientifically material rather than merely anecdotal.
Experiment receipt synchronization passed with 314 imported receipts and zero hash mismatches, supporting receipt integrity within the stated sync process.

The evidence framework preserves negative and inconclusive results rather than presenting only supportive candidates: state counts include 6 not supported, 32 inconclusive, and 8 target-unit quarantined.
All escalation-queue entries explicitly have canonical_effect=false and portfolio_execution=false, preserving the research-only boundary.
hypotheses: Highest-information-value new preregistered hypothesis: on a non-overlapping prospective cohort of at least 25 matured outcomes, the completely unchanged frozen specification of BTC mark-price RANGE candidate EC-0dc8abd903144198e36e will produce positive incremental value on a preregistered primary proper score versus both an unconditional range baseline and a time-matched null baseline. It is falsified if its score improvement is less than or equal to zero against either baseline; a cohort with unverifiable replication, changed horizon or bounds, target-unit ambiguity, or overlapping outcomes is inadmissible rather than supportive.
summary: No new council-level market learning claim is admissible from this review because the maturation trigger is false and only 24 new matured outcomes are recorded against the frozen minimum of 25. Existing prospective evidence contains several substantial supported cohorts, especially ETH mark-price DOWN and BTC mark-price RANGE, but these remain unratified research objects. What was actually learned at audit level is that title-level labels are insufficient: apparently identical RANGE or DOWN titles can be supported and not supported across candidate IDs, target-unit integrity has quarantined eight tests, and replication remains unverified. The strongest claims are therefore candidate-specific evidence observations, not general market rules. Small-N range results, one-outcome sensor combinations, descriptive calibration, collecting snapshots, duplicates, replay/workflow presence, and immature registry states do not constitute learning. The bounded question with highest information value is whether the largest supported BTC RANGE candidate retains incremental value under unchanged specifications, independent outcomes, verified replication, and explicit baselines.
uncertainties: The supplied evidence does not expose the exact horizon, range bounds, thresholds, scoring rules, signal conditions, or evaluation dates for any candidate.
Outcome independence is unknown. Candidates sharing a title may use overlapping timestamps or forecasts, so their matured counts cannot be safely pooled.
The relationship among 310 outcome JSON files, the prior total of 286, the delta of 24, and the architecture-health count of 179 is not specified; these may represent different scopes or windows.
REPLICATED_FIRED and REPLICATION_UNVERIFIED appear together, but the missing verification step and independence standard are not described.
The reason same-title candidates have different lifecycle outcomes is unknown; specification, horizon, regime, baseline, or data-source differences may explain the disagreement.
No effect sizes, uncertainty intervals, calibration scores, null comparisons, or regime-stratified results are supplied, so statistical and economic significance remain unlearned.
The impact of the failed daily-slow-cycle-shadow workflow, stale lifecycle schedule, missing workflow files, and 121.7-hour weekly-calibration freshness on evidence completeness cannot be determined.
No replay result is supplied. The presence of replay or historical workflows is operational metadata and cannot establish prospective validity.
